verdicts.reason: A drops the product can entirely and crams everything together: the SUNSET SALE ribbon sits on top of the logo and headline, the legal fine print comes right under the headline as if it were the second message, the body copy is almost as big as the headline, and the badges, the CTA and a missing-asset placeholder are jammed into the bottom-right corner. B keeps the product and gives the CTA real presence, but the body copy is moved above the headline at an unreadable size, the headline is squeezed into a narrow column that wraps over 9 lines, the SUNSET SALE, LIMITED EDITION, AWARD WINNING and SMALL BATCH badges shrink to illegible slivers, the SOLSTICE logo is gone except on the can, and a missing-asset placeholder still sits in the bottom-right corner. B is the less broken of the two.
